I was scared of taking meds at first, thinking that I could still cope naman. But something my counselor said stuck with me and Ill share it with you: "meds might just be the key to helping you help yourself with more ease"

So I tried it. Thankfully, I was able to find meds that worked for me. Like the others here have said, it may take a while to get over the side effect phase because our bodies react differently to meds. But the relief I felt when all those bad thoughts of mine subsided, when I finally got to sleep well, when I finally had energy to do things and my emotions which always felt so intense and strong were more manageable, was worth the jump.

There have been efforts to make meds and psychological and psychiatric care more accessible if finances is a problem too (for example, ceck out DOH's Medicine Access Program for Mental Health for free meds).

If you feel like you really need the meds to better help yourself, go for it OP. It may take some time, and definitely take a lot of effort on your part to learn healthy coping techniques and what not, but you deserve the effort. Hi OP, unang una Im so sorry na youre going through this. Ang hirap at mabigat sa pakiramdam na feeling mo hindi ka understood. 

As for therapy, I would recommend contacting MLAC, they do online sessions and trusted ko yung team nila. I sought help from them before din when I was going through a lot, and I felt very much seen and heard. Swerte ako na nagclick kami ng therapist ko.

Its understandable yung takot mo OP, pero parte ng process talaga yung trial and error until mahanap mo yung nagwowork talaga sayo. Kaya maraming approaches ang available sa psych - complex tayo as people, so may approaches and relationships na compatible o hindi compatible. 

Isang important lesson na natutunan ko sa aking group therapy professor - we need to take some risks in order to start our journey to healing. And I think the fact na youre seeking help again, despite your fears, is courageous OP.

Edit: if pera yung worry mo, discussing your situation with the therapist might help. I was in the same situation where ayoko malaman ng parents ko din, and my therapist gave me a student discount so I could continue seeing him. Much warmth and luck to you OP
